meta.title: AgentBridge — Degraded Mode & Fault Isolation Workflow
meta.subtitle: GitHub Outage Isolation: Local Git and System Services Remain 100% Operational
meta.description: Workflow proving that when GitHub REST is completely down (circuit breaker OPEN), AgentBridge gracefully degrades remote actions while keeping Local Git, Telegram ChatOps, Codebase Explorer, and Agent Runtime fully active.

states.label: GitHub Upstream Outage Occurs
states.description: GitHub REST endpoints return repeated HTTP 500/502/503/504 or experience complete network blackouts.

states.label: Circuit Breaker Trips to OPEN
states.description: After 5 consecutive failures, github_rest breaker opens and triggers 30-second cooldown timer.

states.label: User Requests Arrive via Telegram
states.description: Operator dispatches either local workstation commands or remote GitHub collaboration commands.

states.label: GitHub Request (PR / CI / Release)
states.description: Request reaches resilience boundary while circuit breaker is OPEN.

states.label: Check Stale Read Cache
states.description: Evaluate if safe read data (e.g. PR details, release notes) exists in CacheStore.

states.label: Serve Degraded Cached Data
states.description: Return cached information accompanied by '(Degraded: upstream unavailable)' indicator.

states.label: Fast-Fail GitHub Operation
states.description: Return clean normalized CIRCUIT_OPEN error immediately without network delay or hung socket.

states.label: Local Git Request (/git status, diff, commit)
states.description: Local Git commands execute directly on workstation .git repository.

states.label: Codebase Explorer / Search / Files
states.description: File system navigation, previews, symbol discovery, and exports.

states.label: Agent Runtime & ChatOps Heartbeats
states.description: Control plane sessions, doctor diagnostics, and pairing continue without interruption.

states.label: Local Operations Succeed (100% Availability)
states.description: Local workstation remains fully productive despite remote cloud outage.
